summary: This Form 6-K filed by Inventiva S.A. on May 26, 2026, reports first-quarter 2026 financial information via a press release. It discloses cash, cash equivalents and short-term deposits totaling €196.5 million as of March 31, 2026, with no revenues recognized. The company estimates funding to mid-Q1 2027, or mid-Q3 2027 if Tranche 3 warrants from an October 2024 structured financing are fully exercised for up to €116.0 million. This is a routine periodic financial update, not a special situation. No corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or similar triggers classification.
